title: Prefill: MXFP8 / BF16 GEMMs, router/latent, AttnRes, small ops
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: baseline: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 (INFRA 17:48, int b31121cf56). current: int 5718ef2 profiled slice (trial3), my changes not yet in-step. achievable = nvfp4_modelopt at the same slice
gap_analysis: MEASURED on int 5718ef2 (INFRA trial3 profiled slice, pf16k, per MoE layer, rank0): the GEMM mainloops are at 1.00-1.09x model (cuBLASLt nvjet sm_107 2-CTA). The family excess is glue the model prices as fused/free: shared SiTU+MXFP8 quant act_quant 160 us/layer (x23 = 3.7 ms; floor 36 us; MUFU-bound: 3 precise tanhf per element), FlashInfer MXFP8 quant of the AttnRes output 40 us x 41 calls (1.6 ms; removed by B1 attn_res_mxfp8), router top-k 65 us/layer (1.5 ms; byte floor 4 us; latency-bound: 1 token per 128-thread block, 3 of 4 warps idle in the serial select), latent RMSNorm 29 us/layer (0.67 ms; floor 17), DSA gate sigmoid-mul 131 us/call x6 (floor 58; 2 MUFU per element), dense BF16 SiTU 221 us/call x3, router GEMM 78 vs 58 us (N=896 waves). In pf_fam these land in MOE.latent_norm (catch-all: act_quant + FI quant + rms 5.55 ms vs 0.04 model) and MOE.topk (1.51 vs 0.02).
inefficiencies: MEASURED: shared SiTU+MXFP8 quant pass 116 us/layer (92/step = 10.7 ms) vs model 9.2 us: MUFU-bound precise tanhf (3 per element); only hideable inside the gate_up GEMM epilogue (SOL design B3). Model error: shared_act / MOE.topk SIMT cost ignores the precise-transcendental MUFU cost when unfused
MEASURED: router top-k 43 us/layer vs 4 us floor (precise sigmoid over 896 logits per token); router GEMM 1.30x (N=896 wave quantization)
MEASURED: standalone MXFP8 quant of the AttnRes output (40 us FlashInfer) per KDA in_proj / shared gate_up call - removed by attn_res_mxfp8 (B1, step A/B running)
MEASURED: native AttnRes 1.31-1.37x its byte floor; fused variant adds 15-25 us (serial per-token epilogue, 1 CTA/SM): needs a 2-token-per-SM redesign (B2)
MEASURED: DSA w_uk bmm 1.52x (P-MLA fuses q-quant into it), KDA f_b_proj 1.54x (402 MB BF16 write), dense down 1.25x
rubin_features: 2-CTA M256 tiles (full-rate operand fetch), exclusive TMEM allocation
oversized shared memory for deeper A/B pipelines
epilogue fusion (MXFP8 quant in producer epilogues)
plan: SOL DESIGN (per family, bound resource): tensor-bound GEMMs stay on cuBLASLt 2-CTA tactics (at model). Every transcendental glue pass becomes HBM-bound or disappears: SiTU / sigmoid inputs are BF16, so the precise-transcendental result is a function of a 16-bit input -> per-CTA shared-memory tables built with the exact stock expressions (bitwise equal, out-of-window values computed directly), turning the MUFU-bound passes into HBM-streaming passes; router top-k one token per warp in registers (issue-bound ~10 us); AttnRes writes the MXFP8 GEMM input (B1). Projected family after these: ~79.5 ms vs target 79.97 (achievable 72.7).
C1 (implemented 20:30, testing): SiTU+MXFP8 by table (act_quant mode 4, >= 1024 rows); router top-k one warp per token. Projected -2.6 ms (act 160->~50 us/layer) and -1.2 ms (top-k 65->~12).
C2 (implemented): BF16 tables for DSA gate_sigmoid_mul (-0.4 ms) and dense BF16 SiTU (-0.3 ms).
B1 (done earlier): attn_res_mxfp8 removes 41 FI quant passes/step (-1.6 ms) minus fused epilogue cost; confirm in the profiled slice.
Then: latent RMSNorm at its byte floor (-0.3 ms), router GEMM N=896 tactic (-0.4 ms); stretch SOL: shared gate_up GEMM with SiTU+MXFP8 epilogue (removes the 403 MB BF16 round trip, -1 ms).
Validate: bitwise unit tests + 1-GPU glue bench (runs/P-GEMM/c1,c2), then profiled step_p -q nvfp4 on the overlay vs int reference (198.9 ms F16K; per-group from trial3 prof).
